text: Read-only follow-up to the completed D01 pilot: independent NumPy/SciPy reconstruction reproduces coarse-end/fine-start scalar support positive counts exactly (45,591 and 149,189) and support sums within 2.5e-9 (declared tolerance 1e-7). All 12 raw map metadata/coordinate/validity identities match the prior independent verifier. Fixed native mask occupies 365,983/2,276,640 voxels; mask-normalized coarse Gaussian threshold expands valid fraction to 64,533/286,440. Warped fixed validity is 57,987 coarse /290,387 fine; joint validity is identical because moving validity is not limiting. One-voxel safety erosion leaves 45,591 coarse /149,189 fine (~15.9%/~6.6% of each grid). Frozen RealImageRegistration constructs fixed RegistrationImage with the provided mask, but moving RegistrationImage with default All validity. This asymmetry and the pyramid validity/erosion population change are confirmed behavior; whether they explain anatomical regression or violate the intended objective remains unproven. Use actual image-order/pyramid derivative experiments to test them. No optimizer policy changed and no fresh qualification data/labels opened. D02 remains prerequisite-blocked pending D01 panel completion; this is a diagnostic finding, not milestone completion.
